Stated Claim / Post Context:
Highway truck and car crash leaves man in serious condition

A truck and car collided near Goulburn in the early hours of Tuesday.

Actual Article Body:

Access unlimited news content and The Canberra Times app. Premium subscribers also enjoy interactive puzzles and access to the digital version of our print edition - Today's Paper.

A man has been flown to hospital following a crash on the Hume Highway north of Goulburn.

Login or signup to continue reading

Police said a witness reported that a work utility had crashed into the rear of a semitrailer at about 5.40am on Tuesday, November 17, near the Hume Highway's intersection with Rampion Hills Road, about 20km north of Goulburn.

Emergency services arrived a short time later. Police said the utility's driver was trapped by injury. Police Rescue worked to free him.

A NSW Ambulance media spokesperson said a man in his 40s, believed to be the utility's driver, was treated for back, leg and abdominal injuries. Intensive care paramedics attended the scene and a rescue helicopter landed nearby. The man was later flown to Canberra Hospital in a serious condition.

The semitrailer's driver was believed to have been uninjured.

Police reported significant debris and tools over the road. The semitrailer's load was unknown.

The highway's southbound lanes were closed for a short time but have since been reopened.
